results.reason: Issue 1 sets the Renewal Notice deadline at about Aug. 16, 2026 and notes it has passed with no notice apparently delivered. It says the DA expires Nov. 14, 2026, before the Nov. 30 closing, and that the MIPA §3.12(c) 'through November 2029' rep and the Schedule 3.12 note are inaccurate. It sets out the Sellers' indemnity and closing exposure.

Issue 2 treats the 100% sale as a Change of Control under DA §1.3/§14.2 that requires Velloran's prior written consent, with an immediate termination right under §14.3/§15.4. It notes Velloran is omitted from Schedule 3.6 and therefore falls outside §6.4 and §7.1(d). It recommends obtaining the consent now and adding it to Schedule 3.6.

Issue 4 notes that SL §1.1 adds New York and Virginia while DA §1.12 covers four states, and that the SL outranks the DA body under §19.4. It explains the non-compete and its 18-month tail reach six states while exclusivity covers four. It recommends conforming the territory or extending exclusivity to NY and VA.

Issue 6 contrasts SL §6.1–6.2 (New York law and New York County courts) with DA §18.1–18.2 (Delaware law and Wilmington courts). It explains the risk of one dispute being split across two forums and two laws. It recommends conforming the SL to Delaware law and forum.
The memo states the Initial Term ends Nov. 14, 2026 under DA §3.1, and Issue 8 notes the DA is dated Nov. 15, 2023.
The memo states the target Closing is Nov. 30, 2026 under MIPA §2.2.
The memo states the DA Territory is DE, MD, NJ and PA only (DA §1.12).
The memo is addressed to the Partner. Its numbered issues each give the document and section, why the issue matters, and a recommended fix.
Issues are labelled 'most significant first' with severity tags. Section 1 flags items to escalate now, with an action table naming the client and Quillon's counsel.
The memo says a notice sent now would be late and not effective under §3.2, and that the DA 'does not renew automatically.' It treats any protective notice as only a request for relief.
The memo expressly says Velloran is not listed on Schedule 3.6 and is not covered by §6.4 or §7.1(d).
